text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby... you came.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Since you specifically nominated me, I have given it consideration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Gâ¡ Swan Stakes...
After KS Miracle suggested it, they and Daiichi Ruby decided to run.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I never thought I'd get to run with you again so soon.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...It appears you are feeling well,
which is good to see."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm okay now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I used to push myself recklessly, thinking as long as I got faster, nothing else mattered, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I changed up my training so that I could bring out the absolute best of what I'm capable of right now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so,
I'm confident I'm faster now.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: More than you...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just as I promised, I've grown stronger.
—Come, test your strength against mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle smiles.
Though gentle, there is an unmistakable confidence
evident in her demeanor...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is mine.
I look forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Be friends with us too, okay?! Yayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Heli-chan in the buildiiing!
And nooow♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yooo--!!
Ban-cham, yooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha☆
Not quite what I taught you, but it's cool!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Just like that? Let's barge right into the Swan Stakes!
Gotta spread those wings, here we go♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Vroom, v-v-v-vroooom!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I have received
both of your determination.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Everyone else is full of motivation too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And who are you?
Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I cannot answer that.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —The results will speak for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I mean... this lineup is totally GⅠ-tier!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone could take the win here, but...
how will it all play out!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, amidst the swirling excitement,
the race begins...!
